annotations.title: Ask Genaya to prepare a change

description: Run Genaya on one request that may CHANGE something (a task, client, lead, appointment, estimate or invoice draft, expense, a reschedule, cancel or complete, a text or email) as the connected member. Nothing runs here: each proposal comes back in actions with its preview and body_hash. confirm_channel in_chat means the member confirms in this chat (an elicitation, or confirm_action with the body_hash); genaya_page means show confirm_url and stop - the member confirms on a Genaya page. status needs_info means ask the member for needs_info and call again with everything in one message. Money, billing, roles, phone numbers and automations are not available here, and neither is creating an image or a video. One call is 10 Genaya credits when it only answers and 20 when it prepares a change; same input rules as ask_genaya.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id from an earlier answer in this session, to continue that thread (a follow-up about the same records). Leave it out for a new standalone question.

entity.description: A record to focus on, taken from an earlier answer's sources (collection and id). Never invented.

idempotency_key.description: A fresh 16 to 64 character key per question; a retry with the same key replays the finished answer instead of running (and metering) again.

message.description: One question, in plain language, with its period or filter spelled out (today, this week, last month, a client's name). Never two questions in one message.
